notice: Synthetic demonstration residents only. These are invented personas used to show the system end to end; they are not real people and contain no real personal data.

residents.name: Sam
residents.text: I lost my warehouse job about six months ago. I've got a bad back now so I can't do heavy lifting, but I really want to get back into work. I could use some help updating my CV.

residents.scenario: B — too little information, needs a clarifying question
residents.name: Alex
residents.text: Hi, I think I need some help but I'm not really sure where to start.

residents.scenario: C — career changer wanting to retrain
residents.name: Priya
residents.text: I've worked in retail for ten years as a sales assistant and I'm good with customers and work well in a team. I'd like to retrain and get into IT, maybe start with a digital skills course. I'd prefer face to face support near me.

residents.name: Joan
residents.text: I'm a full-time carer for my mum. I used to do admin work years ago. I've lost my confidence and I'd like help updating my CV and some interview practice. Evenings would suit me best around my caring.

residents.scenario: E — health condition, wants suitable work and adjustments
residents.name: Marcus
residents.text: I have a health condition that affects what I can do physically, but I want to stay in work. I'm employed at the moment and worried about keeping my job. I'd like to know about adjustments and any support.

residents.scenario: F — would match a time-limited / closed programme
residents.name: Dan
residents.text: I'm 22 and on Universal Credit. Someone mentioned a scheme that paid for young people's job placements and I wondered if I could still get on something like that. I'm looking for work in a warehouse or driving.
